<!--
Please read CONTRIBUTING.md before filing, in particular the "Adding a new
package" section and the notes on AI/LLM usage.

Every package carries an ongoing maintenance cost that is usually paid by
the maintainers, so the question is not only whether the software can be
packaged, but whether enough OmniOS users will use it to justify that
cost. Requests are much more likely to go somewhere if you are willing to
do the packaging work yourself, or to help maintain it afterwards.
-->

<!-- In your own words, and please be realistic -->

**Does it build on OmniOS today?**
<!-- Have you tried? Are there known illumos or OmniOS portability issues? -->

**Are you able to help?**
<!-- Submitting the package, testing it, maintaining it in future -->
